seo_title: Cost of Living in Alicante 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Alicante per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A city on the Costa Blanca with beaches and a seafront: a mild climate, a large Russian-speaking community and well-developed infrastructure. Russian citizens need a visa (a nomad visa or D7 works well), and it gets crowded in summer.
